## Confidence Interval for $\mu_1-\mu_2$

- (1--$\alpha$)100% CI for a population mean, $\mu_1-\mu_2$

$$\bar{y} \pm t_{\alpha/2, n-1} \frac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$$

- $t$ has $n-1$ degrees of freedom (df).
